subject: spanish
title: Garcia Marquez and Magical Realism
welcome_lead: Gabriel Garcia Marquez's Cien anos de soledad founded magical realism. The novel is a Latin American touchstone.
meta_desc: Spanish HL Literature: Garcia Marquez, magical realism.
final_note: Macondo es Latinoamerica y Latinoamerica es Macondo.

concepts.def: Fictional Caribbean town of the novel.
Magical realism — supernatural treated as ordinary.

walkthroughs.body_html: Muchos anos despues, frente al peloton de fusilamiento, el coronel Aureliano Buendia habia de recordar aquella tarde remota en que su padre lo llevo a conocer el hielo. Three time frames in one sentence.
Remedios ascends to heaven while folding sheets. The narrator reports it deadpan. The mix of registers is the politics.
Macondo's banana company massacre echoes the 1928 United Fruit massacre. Magic carries history.
